project_context.archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) / Light Variant - 'Light Refined Elegance'
key_elements: Contact section with social links and profile photo

body.styling: Clean, highly legible, modern contrast to the serif headings.

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use 2x normal spacing (p-12, py-24) to create a luxurious, breathable feel.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grids: For services, use an asymmetrical grid (e.g., md:grid-cols-12) to create visual tension and interest.
layout_and_spacing.container: Max-w-7xl mx-auto, large horizontal paddings (px-6 md:px-12).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Use 1px delicate borders (border-[#1C1C1C]/10) rather than heavy drop shadows.

hero.type: Split layout or large minimal typography over subtle abstract background.
hero.overlay: If using image, white/20 glassmorphism overlay to ensure text contrast while maintaining brightness.

buttons.primary: Solid dark charcoal background (#2A2A2A), white text, rounded-none or very slight rounded (rounded-sm), hover:bg-brand-primary (#C5A880) with smooth transition.
buttons.secondary: Outline button with 1px border (#2A2A2A), transparent background, hover:bg-[#F3F2F0].
buttons.stripe_payments: Must be clearly marked as payment CTAs. Elegant but highly visible. Use primary button style.

cards.style: Neumorphic/Glass mixed: Solid #FFFFFF background with 1px border, extremely soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]). Hover: slight upward translation (-translate-y-1).

navigation.header: Crystal Glass style: bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-black/5, sticky top-0 z-50.

testimonials_banner.style: The 'Editorial Ribbon'. Full width marquee, very slow speed. Cormorant Garamond font, large text (text-3xl), massive gaps between items (gap-32).

motion_and_interaction.scroll: MUST use lenis library for smooth momentum scrolling. It's critical for the 'fluid' requirement.
motion_and_interaction.animations: Framer Motion for soft fade-in-up on scroll (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle scale-up (1.02) on portfolio images. Slow transitions (duration-300 to 500).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Charcoal (#1C1C1C) on #FAFAFA is highly readable.
accessibility_and_testing.test_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).

inspiration_reference.description: Ring photo to guide the luxury/refined aesthetic
inspiration_reference.usage: Do not display on UI directly, purely for thematic alignment (champagne/gold/white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Open Sans', etc., for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Outfit for body. Include them from Google Fonts in index.html.
Avoid typical SaaS cards. Use flat, sharp or slightly rounded elements with a 1px border (#1C1C1C opacity 10%) and very soft ambient shadow.
Keep spacing generous (e.g., py-24, gap-12). It must feel breathable and 'fluid'.
Include a 'testimonal' marquee using an infinite scroll library (e.g., react-fast-marquee) or Framer Motion.
Payment links to Stripe should be prominent and styled beautifully. Do not bury them.
Ensure the layout feels 'Godly' - asymmetrical, high information density but highly skimmable, image-led storytelling.
Map provided assets strictly. Do not use generic placeholders. Add data-testid to all CTA buttons.
